ITEM 1 | Bright green floret cluster with dense, bumpy, tree-like buds and some paler green stems, slightly glossy surface with small dark specks, upper right of plate, about 7 x 6 cm, sits in a loose group with the other florets | 75
ITEM 2 | Medium-dark green floret cluster with tight, granular buds and a pale stalk end, matte and slightly moist, center-right of plate, about 6 x 5 cm, touching items 1 and 3 | 55
ITEM 3 | Cluster of dark green florets with fine textured tops and a thick pale stalk extending to the right, slightly glossy, right edge of plate, about 8 x 5 cm, overlapping the florets below | 60
ITEM 4 | Dark green floret cluster with fine, bumpy buds and a pale light-green stalk, matte, lower center-right of plate, about 7 x 5 cm, piled on item 5 | 65
ITEM 5 | Small dark green floret piece with a pale stalk, slightly wilted, lower left of plate, about 4 x 3 cm, isolated on the white plate surface | 22
ITEM 6 | Dark blackish-green elongated stem fragment with a wrinkled, slightly charred look and a thin pale edge, center of plate, about 4 x 2 cm, lying beside item 2 | 8
ITEM 7 | Small crumbs and tiny bits of pale green and yellowish matter scattered around the florets, dry and flaky, center of plate, less than 1 cm each | 2
